### Notes

The public page lists partner names and headline offers in a table but publishes no eligibility criteria and no per-perk terms; redemption terms, per-partner eligibility and any Mercury account requirements sit behind the Mercury dashboard login, which I could not inspect. The page also does not state whether a Mercury account is required to redeem, only "Sign up to access perks". Imported from a verification sweep whose quote fidelity later failed audit in 13 of 22 sampled records. This entry was NOT independently re-audited, so the evidence quote may be a close paraphrase rather than the vendor's exact wording. Re-read the source before relying on precise phrasing. Re-confirmed 2026-09-16. The page publishes no aggregate value. A Mercury account is required: the call to action reads 'Sign up to access perks'. Individual perks shown are third-party offers (for example AWS and QuickBooks), not Mercury credit.
